_doc: Core compact catalog with automatic wave growth set aside. enhance_video's resolution enum (+55 B, #861 2K export) and extract_audio's part enum (+85 B, #386 clip music) are paid for by trims that lose no fact: enhance_video gets a compact line naming the export size, extract_audio's line is tightened, and set_picture_card, apply_look and add_zoom drop prose that restated their own property names and enum values.
